about: World tiers I-IV (docs/design/ARPG.md section 7.3), read by logic/Content/WorldTiers.cs. The world fact 'world.tier' picks one (default below). health/damage scale the foes of story fights (never allies, arenas or maps); itemLevels is added to drop levels; rare/legendary multiply the drop chances; kit scales only the telegraph kit's damage (its blows are a share of her max life, so they do not take the x3/x6); kitEvery (M3) multiplies the kit's waits (champions' affixes, packs' tells: under 1, more marks); stand (M3) is the stand clock (H6's rule, Teeth.Director's stand fields, logic/Play/Zones/StandClock.cs through PackKit.cs): a woken pack's foe charges her when she has not moved standMoved m in standFor s, from within standNear (at least standFrom off), at standScale and standDamage x the kit's charge, a second from another side (standPair 2), at most once each standCooldown s; standGrow (M3 round 5, III/IV) adds that share of its damage for each second she has stood past standFor, at most standGrowMax. Story fights read the world's tier; the Wayfinder's maps (M3 round 4) read kit, kitEvery and stand from the row of their chart's tier (WorldTiers.ForMap: tiers past IV ride IV) through the same PackKit, and keep their own health and damage. opens: the world fact that unlocks the tier (null: always open).
